name: Unibic Choco nut Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm), Chocolate Chips (5%) (Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter, Dextrose, Emulsifiers RDA (INS 322, INS 476), Cashew Bits (4%), Cocoa Powder, Milk Solids, Leavening Agents ving (INS 503 ii, INS 500 ii), Emulsifier (INS 322 from Soy), lodised Salt, Artificial Flavouring Substance (Vanillin).
